title: Password reset route lacks endpoint-level regression coverage
reasoning: The public password reset and confirm routes are wired, but the included tests only validate that the password reset email template renders with a supplied reset_url. They do not exercise POSTing to /api/password/reset/, request validation, unknown-user behavior, email dispatch, generated reset URL shape, or the confirm route contract. Because this endpoint accepts unauthenticated network input and sends account recovery email, route/view regressions could ship while the template test still passes.
recommendation: Add endpoint-level tests for /api/password/reset/ and /api/password/reset/confirm/ covering valid requests, malformed input, non-existent email behavior, email generation, and successful/invalid token confirmation responses.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The only password-reset-related included test renders email/password_reset.html directly with a fabricated reset_url; it bypasses URL routing, PasswordResetView, serializers, token generation, and email sending.
suggestedRegressionTest: Use DRF/APIClient to POST an existing user's email to /api/password/reset/, assert the response contract and one email containing a usable reset link, then POST valid and invalid payloads to /api/password/reset/confirm/ and assert password change/token rejection behavior.
minimumFixScope: Tests for hub password reset API routes and their expected response/email contracts.
